reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by the constant 100, which is not in the Datadog source; this violates the no-numeric-constants rule and is an unjustified unit scale.
The Datadog query is a plain avg by docker_image of docker.io.write_bytes with no rate or percent conversion, so the 100x factor makes the unit and magnitude differ.

The OTel metric container.blockio.io_service_bytes_recursive has device_major and device_minor attributes, so the series are per device. avg by container_image_name averages across devices and containers rather than per container series, which changes the aggregation and series set; a caveat belongs in notes.

The candidate applies rate() to a monotonic sum, which is allowed, and groups by container_image_name, which is an observed label. The translated outcome is acceptable if the scale and aggregation are corrected.
